mapper.select: select * from SYS_FlowActivity where ActFlowID = #{flowId} and ActType = 'startEvent' limit 1

select tp.*, us.U_Name as uName from Sys_Task_Processin tp left join SYS_User us on tp.tp_user = us.U_ID left join SYS_FlowActivity act on act.ActID = tp.tp_actid where tp.tp_entityid = #{entityId} and act.ActType not like '%Gateway' order by tp.tp_dotime asc
